summary: Cirrus SR22 N462SR with a family of four aboard (pilot Jeff Makepeace, 47, wife Jennifer Hickey Makepeace, and 10-year-old twins Addison and Benjamin) crashed in mountainous terrain near Glenwood Springs on a night VFR flight from Fort Collins to Moab; the non-instrument-rated pilot flew into instrument conditions and lost control; Garfield County SAR and Civil Air Patrol launched a search Saturday morning and located the wreckage ~11:37 a.m.; all four aboard killed
location: near Baxter Peak, ~9 mi north of Rifle
responding_agency: Garfield County Search and Rescue; Civil Air Patrol
notes: NTSB probable cause: non-instrument-rated pilot's inadequate preflight weather planning, departure into forecast instrument conditions, continued VFR flight into IMC -> spatial disorientation and loss of control. ELT installed but not activated; Cirrus airframe-parachute system equipped. Date = NTSB accident date (Friday 2017-09-15 per weekday verification); wreckage located 11:37 a.m. Saturday 2017-09-16.
